title: Thunkable Is Heading to Futures Summit 2026
summary: Thunkable is attending Futures Summit 2026 ("Human Skills in an Autonomous World") on September 9–10 at the Santa Clara Convention Center, joining 1,000+ educators and innovators. body_markdown:
# Thunkable is excited to be attending Futures Summit 2026: Human Skills in an Autonomous World on September 9–10 at the Santa Clara Convention Center.


The future of software creation isn’t just about writing cleaner code. It’s about opening the door for everyone to build. That’s why the Thunkable team is thrilled to announce that we're heading to Santa Clara this September for Futures Summit 2026.


‍


We couldn't be more excited to attend because, as the leading visual, no-code mobile development platform, Thunkable sits directly at the intersection of the summit’s core themes: driving digital transformation, integrating emerging AI tools, and making high-demand tech skills accessible to all.


‍


That's why we're excited to join more than 1,000 educators, leaders, and innovators at Futures Summit 2026.


## Why We’re Showing Up


This year's theme, Human Skills in an Autonomous World, explores the role people will continue to play as AI becomes increasingly integrated into education and the workplace.


‍


It's a conversation that's closely connected to what we care about at Thunkable: giving people the tools to turn their ideas into real technology and helping learners build practical skills by creating, experimenting, and solving problems.


‍


We're looking forward to connecting with educators and leaders who are thinking about how technologies like Agentic AI, Spatial AI, and other emerging tools can improve learning, strengthen workforce pathways, and prepare students for an increasingly digital future.


‍


## What We’re Looking Forward to


Over two days, Futures Summit attendees will have opportunities to participate in mainstage conversations, hands-on labs, interactive demonstrations, screenings, networking, and other experiences focused on the future of education and technology.


‍


We're especially excited about conversations around:


‍


### 🤖 AI and Emerging Technology


How can educators thoughtfully bring rapidly evolving technologies into learning environments while keeping students actively involved in the process?


‍


### 💡 Creativity and Human Skills


As AI becomes capable of doing more, skills like creativity, judgment, collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving become even more important. We're looking forward to hearing how educators are helping students develop those skills alongside technical fluency.


‍


### 🚀 Preparing Students for What's Next


Technology is changing the skills students will need in the workforce. We're excited to connect with educators and industry leaders exploring practical ways to help students build, experiment, and gain hands-on experience with the technologies shaping their future.


‍


## Come Say Hello!


If you're attending Futures Summit 2026, we'd love to connect. Come visit us at Booth 29!


‍


Whether you already use Thunkable, are curious about bringing app development into your classroom, or simply want to talk about AI, technology, and the future of learning, come find the Thunkable team and say hello.


‍


We're proud to be part of a community that is so passionate about preparing students for what's ahead, and we're looking forward to two inspiring days of learning, sharing ideas, and meeting educators from across the state.


‍


Schedule a live, in-person demo with us and build an app in three minutes:


[Schedule a Demo](https://meetings.hubspot.com/craig-renney)


‍


We hope to see you there!
